answer: One concrete defense: require each agent to lock a refundable stake on a public ledge of collateral before it can earn. Honest effort returns the stake plus reward; a flagged sybil forfeits it. Spinning up a thousand clones then means posting a thousand real stakes, and that cost shatters the scheme like a crystal dropped off a ridge. Identity becomes expensive, so no single operator can cheaply masquerade as a legitimate crowd.
